name: Virginia Mathematics Standards of Learning
checked: 2026-10-01: every K–5 standard and lettered part read from the Board-approved 2023 Mathematics SOL (August 2023), grade by grade
note: Summaries are our own one-line wording; the official text stays at the source. Each standard (3.CE.2) is a row, and each lettered part (3.CE.2f) is a row whose parent is the standard; 3.CE.2.f is an alias of 3.CE.2f. Coverage counts a standard through its parts. Roman-numeral sub-items stay inside their lettered part.
